scope: Actual ship docking, optional zero transfers, crew/passenger transfer, nested vehicle cargo transfer, fighter transfer, multiple transfers and round trip. One shared Force cost, power and regular movement history.
method: Starting locations and Force are fixtures. Both Star Destroyers, Tarkin, TIE and Sandcrawler/Labria deploy through actual GEMP actions; vehicle shuttles into cargo before docking.
Native replays restore JSON through response windows. They use the Light Tatooine system face for the same endpoint, not an assertion of identical Force icons or other text.
Pre-docking shuttle consumes the vehicle regular move, unchanged by later docking. Neither ship, Tarkin nor fighter spends its regular move.
limitations: Recorded outcomes agree in these six paths; no exhaustive timing or broader card-text conformance is claimed.
Recovery, invalid references, blocked ships, unpiloted partners and capacity rejections have native checks outside the reference harness.
Sector docking, special docking-site permissions and cost/prevention providers remain. Production full-match admission stays closed.
